Title: REQ-REG-001 - Regulatory Source Monitoring
Description: The platform shall proactively monitor approved regulatory sources and detect new, changed and unavailable publications.

Title: US-REG-001 - Regulatory Source Monitoring
Description: As a Compliance Officer, I want approved regulatory sources monitored automatically so that new or amended requirements enter the compliance process without manual website checking.

Title: REQ-DOC-001 - Secure Document Ingestion
Description: The platform shall securely retrieve, validate, hash, quarantine where necessary, version and preserve original regulatory documents.

Title: US-DOC-001 - Secure Document Ingestion
Description: As a Compliance Officer, I want source documents securely captured and preserved so that regulatory evidence is trustworthy and traceable.

Title: REQ-AI-001 - Document Intelligence
Description: The platform shall extract agreed factual regulatory fields from supported documents and expose extraction confidence/quality for human validation.

Title: US-AI-001 - Document Intelligence
Description: As a Compliance Officer, I want regulatory fields extracted automatically so that I can validate rather than re-key information manually.

Title: REQ-AI-002 - AI-assisted Classification
Description: The platform may recommend applicability, affected business units and obligations, but recommendations shall remain advisory and human-confirmed.

Title: US-AI-002 - AI-assisted Classification
Description: As a Compliance Officer, I want AI-assisted classification with human override so that assessment is faster without delegating regulatory accountability to AI.

Title: REQ-CRU-001 - CRU Workflow
Description: The platform shall support the controlled CRU lifecycle, including validation, review, rework, approval, version control and segregation of duties.

Title: US-CRU-001 - CRU Workflow
Description: As a Compliance Officer, I want CRU assessments routed through controlled review and approval so that every regulatory assessment is complete, consistent and evidenced.

Title: REQ-CRMP-001 - CRMP & Remediation
Description: The platform shall manage controls, adequacy assessments, gaps, remediation actions, target dates, evidence, closure and residual risk.

Title: US-CRMP-001 - CRMP & Remediation
Description: As a Risk Champion, I want controls and remediation actions tracked against obligations so that compliance gaps are owned and closed on time.

Title: REQ-WFL-001 - Assignment, SLA & Escalation
Description: The platform shall support assignment, reassignment, delegation, SLA calculation, reminders and escalation while preserving ownership history.

Title: US-WFL-001 - Assignment, SLA & Escalation
Description: As a Compliance Manager, I want accountable ownership and SLA escalation so that actions remain owned when staff change roles and overdue work is visible.

Title: REQ-AUD-001 - Audit & Evidence
Description: The platform shall maintain an append-oriented, attributable and searchable business audit trail and evidence chain for material events.

Title: US-AUD-001 - Audit & Evidence
Description: As an Internal Auditor, I want an end-to-end immutable history of regulatory decisions and evidence so that I can reconstruct who did what, when and against which source version.

Title: REQ-IAM-001 - Identity & Authorization
Description: The platform shall authenticate through Microsoft Entra ID and enforce least-privilege, role-based authorization and segregation of duties at UI and API layers.

Title: US-IAM-001 - Identity & Authorization
Description: As a Security Administrator, I want role-based access enforced centrally so that only authorized users can view or perform compliance actions.

Title: REQ-NTF-001 - Notifications
Description: The platform shall send controlled HTML notifications for assignments, reviews, approvals, reminders and escalations, without permitting email-based approval.

Title: US-NTF-001 - Notifications
Description: As an assigned user, I want actionable notifications with secure deep links so that I can act promptly in the authenticated application.

Title: REQ-RPT-001 - Dashboards & Reporting
Description: The platform shall provide role-aware dashboards, drill-downs and authorized exports that reconcile to the Azure SQL system of record.

Title: US-RPT-001 - Dashboards & Reporting
Description: As a Compliance Manager, I want dashboards for regulatory change, approvals and remediation so that I can monitor compliance status without reconstructing email trails.

Title: REQ-INT-001 - API Integrity & Resilience
Description: The platform APIs and integrations shall preserve data integrity using validation, concurrency control, idempotency, safe retry and secure input handling.

Title: US-INT-001 - API Integrity & Resilience
Description: As a Platform Owner, I want resilient and secure APIs so that workflow retries and dependency failures do not corrupt compliance records.

Title: REQ-NFR-001 - Performance & Accessibility
Description: The solution shall meet agreed performance, concurrency, accessibility, responsive-design and browser-compatibility targets.

Title: US-NFR-001 - Performance & Accessibility
Description: As a platform user, I want a responsive and accessible application so that critical compliance work can be completed reliably on supported devices and browsers.

Title: REQ-MIG-001 - Migration
Description: The implementation shall migrate approved legacy CRU/CRMP data with transformation, deduplication, exception handling and field-level reconciliation.

Title: US-MIG-001 - Migration
Description: As a Compliance Data Owner, I want approved historical Excel data migrated and reconciled so that the new platform starts from trusted records.

Title: REQ-OPS-001 - Operations & DR
Description: The production service shall support monitored operations, repeatable infrastructure deployment, backup, restore and disaster recovery to agreed RPO/RTO.

Title: US-OPS-001 - Operations & DR
Description: As a Service Owner, I want the platform recoverable and observable so that regulatory processing can resume safely after failures.

Title: REQ-SEC-001 - Security Verification
Description: The solution shall implement approved application, network and platform security controls and pass security verification before production.

Title: US-SEC-001 - Security Verification
Description: As a Security Architect, I want security controls independently verified so that Internet-sourced documents and privileged compliance actions do not create unacceptable risk.
